name: MedFuzz
description: MedFuzz is an adversarial evaluation method designed to test the robustness of large language models in medical question answering by modifying benchmark questions to confound the models while remaining plausible to medical experts. It quantifies how well LLM performance generalizes when benchmark assumptions are violated, providing insights into model robustness in realistic clinical settings.
reputation: A newer adversarial robustness benchmark that is gaining attention in medical LLM evaluation, but is not yet broadly standardized.
notes: Focuses on adversarial modifications of existing medical QA benchmarks to test robustness; uses permutation test for statistical significance.
